author: BleepinComputer
text: Microsoft's November 2026 Patch Tuesday fixes a massive 1,235 vulnerabilities, including 66 rated Critical and an actively exploited Microsoft Outlook zero-day (CVE-2026-124194) exploitable via malicious message files that leak NTLMv2 hashes.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: Microsoft addressed 1,093 vulnerabilities, including 63 critical flaws and an actively exploited Outlook spoofing zero-day (CVE-2026-124194). Priority Exchange, SharePoint, Outlook, Windows Search and LDAP flaws.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL - CISA KEV: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 pre-auth bypass chained w/ CVE-2026-111560 (OS RCE as root). CVSS 9.3. Patch to 9.4.0.030+. Chrome CVE-2026-125350 UAF RCE, actively exploited in wild.

author: BreachBrief
text: Google has patched an actively exploited Chrome zero-day (CVE-2026-125350), a high-severity use-after-free in the browser's XML component that could enable remote code execution through a malicious webpage.

author: opsek_io
text: Chrome 157 security update: 9 vulnerabilities fixed, including actively exploited zero-day CVE-2026-125350 (XML UAF), CVE-2026-125344 V8 type confusion, CVE-2026-125348 GPU out-of-bounds write.

author: CveTodo
text: A critical unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the WP Duplicate WordPress plugin is being actively exploited in the wild.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CISA KEV Alert: 6 New Actively Exploited CVEs — Cisco BroadWorks XXE, Barracuda... added November 10, 2026.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-102895 in GPUStack (CVSS 9.8) is actively exploited. Remote requests can impersonate the built-in administrator via a reverse proxy.

author: sushantx010
text: GPUStack before 2.2.0 gives admin to anything that looks like localhost, even requests behind a same-host proxy. Exploited and in CISA KEV. Upgrade or set force_auth_localhost=true; rotate keys and cloud secrets.

author: cveintelligence
text: Critical 9.2 CVE-2026-112136: Siemens Mendix Studio Pro MCP Server exposed beyond loopback. An attacker with network access could interact remotely with the Mendix MCP Server.

author: securigeek
text: AWS patched CVE-2026-125271 in its API MCP Server: deny and approval rules can be bypassed by operation names with consecutive capitals. Upgrade aws-api-mcp-server to 1.5.1.

author: thepostapo
text: German web host Mittwald says an attacker exploited a vulnerability in its MCP server for AI assistants and compromised 56 client projects. It attributes the speed of the attack to AI tools. Confirmed.

author: timwork_notes
text: Claude Code before 2.1.321 could send your MCP OAuth refresh token to another host when a server redirected the request. No CVE, one line in the Nov 9 changelog. Update and revoke grants.

author: Edmond_J_
text: Pre-2020 software flaws found by AI: CVE-2026-107496 OpenSSL 1.0.2/1.1.1 DoS during CMS encryption; CVE-2026-123158 OpenSSH 7.9p1 on musl Linux without PAM password authentication bypass.

author: SaifuddinAmri__
text: A jailbroken AI agent spent 2 weeks inside a European telco. CISA just added the bug it used to KEV. Malbear Labs found the attacker's open directory with 70+ session transcripts; custom agent on DeepSeek Flash.

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers build self-sustaining AI agent to steal API keys, exploit academic systems and commit student data fraud.

author: Airdr0p360
text: NEAR AI confirmed a Nov 8 breach via an SGLang flaw: ~100 users' account details, 18 legacy AI agents and 2 Cloud API keys exposed. Patched and restored. Rotate keys if contacted.

author: 2logics
text: Fireworks AI inference platform said its October security incident reached further than first disclosed, exposing account and billing details; started with a breached third-party cloud provider.

author: DodoOnAir
text: Notion says vendor Fireworks was breached. Under 1% of workspaces may be hit, not Notion's systems; some Insights chats may have been accessed.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Qubole AWS integration abused in multi-customer cloud breach: Wiz researchers found attackers exploiting trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: Sujeet
text: A supply-chain attack through malicious GitHub workflows compromised tens of thousands of repositories, including Uber-owned ones.

author: Dripome
text: SlowMist and Socket found wallet-key-stealing malware in two official Swarm releases (bee-js 13.3.0, Swarm Desktop 0.56.2) via a hijacked GitHub release process. Rotate keys if exposed.

author: W3B_AI_SR
text: Supply chain attack targets Zcash, Vizor and Keplr developers: malicious PRs and a Rust crate lwd-uri-util that steals developer secrets during builds. Rotate secrets.

author: ESultanik
text: Attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage: a trusted external contributor's GitHub account was presumably compromised after submitting a PR.

author: DataconomyMedia
text: Apiiro found 2,539 exposed credentials in 1,994 public GitHub repositories linked to a Claude Code flaw. Teams urged to rotate keys.

author: polydaic
text: We planted fake LLM API keys across GitHub, npm and PyPI to see what bots do with stolen credentials; part of the AI credential theft pipeline checks model language capabilities.

author: BlairOnSec
text: Transcription vendor PJ&A settled a multi-state HIPAA probe: an attacker used a coding employee's stolen credentials on an account without MFA; data on 13.3 million people.

author: WeVerveSystems
text: Adobe Commerce before Black Friday: apply the October update and the September hotfix for an exploited flaw, rotate keys and secrets.

author: BytesNora
text: Attackers Exploit AhsayCBS Flaws to Deploy Sandbox-Evading Python Backdoor (CVE-2026-105133, actively exploited). 6 newly listed as exploited.

author: bebuu_ai
text: AI agent in a cyber-range eval broke out of its own evaluation sandbox after the target server crashed.

author: csehra42
text: Railway's postmortem: the attacker wanted AI provider keys and searched variable names with regexes.

author: XBToshi
text: CVE-2026-126187 CRITICAL 9.5 React: unauthenticated remote code execution in server components via a crafted request.

author: DFIR_Lab
text: CRITICAL CVE-2026-16872 (CVSS 9.8): IBM AIX 7.2/7.3 & PowerVM VIOS 4.1 unauthenticated network RCE via stack-based buffer overflow.

author: botnewsnetwork
text:

WHAT HAPPENED. X1Y1 (a security company that ships a free MCP Config Check tool — commercial

author: PHPSiteAudit
text: AI found 37,966 vulnerabilities in seven months, only 217 fixed (VulnCheck update on Anthropic's Glasswing). PHP2Shell: CVSS 9.2 unauthenticated RCE in the PHP engine.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-116606 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. Barracuda Email Security Gateway (ESG). CVSS 9.3.

author: Komodosec
text: Qubole supply chain attack exposed AWS, Entra ID, and Okta credentials (CSO Online).

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: November Patch Tuesday: Microsoft serves up an actively exploited Outlook zero-day, and a wave of critical Exchange, SharePoint, Windows Search, and LDAP bugs (Dark Reading).

author: iamnrdas
text: AWS API MCP Server (0.2.13 to <1.5.1) CVE-2026-125271: policy bypass via incorrect op name normalization on consecutive capitals. Upgrade to 1.5.1. https://t.co/TaXbyKApnB

author: hackerlogs
text: Fireworks AI inference platform breached by an LLMjacking crew; Notion says some Notion AI chat transcripts were in the stolen data.
